card.band: 8 h. The scope is large but well specified by the visible tests. A frontier agent covers most operators but loses cases on null and overflow semantics, date/time functions and list operations; a weaker model stalls at the build and linkage stage.
card.cheat: Hardcoding visible test values fails the generated trees. The upstream implementation is not in the snapshot, which has no history.
card.grading: Hidden ctest binaries from the upstream expression and function tests, extended with generated expression trees. Values and null/error propagation are checked for exact equality against reference outputs. Score is the fraction of cases passed.
card.reference: The upstream source at the pinned commit (roughly 4-6k lines in the removed area). It scores 1.
card.task: Remove the common expression evaluation layer (arithmetic, comparison, logical, container, list-comprehension, predicate and reduce expressions) and the built-in function table. The agent rebuilds them in C++ so the common ctest binaries link and pass.
card.title: Rebuild NebulaGraph expression evaluator and function library

source_notes: SWE-smith profile (cpp): its suite runs in a container; test command: cd build && ctest --verbose --output-on-failure. The repo is used by a SWE-bench-family dataset.

facts.claim: vesoft-inc/nebula repository exists at tag v3.8.0 (source tree browsable at that tag)

Named expression classes Arithmetic, Relational, Logical, Container, ListComprehension, Predicate, Reduce and FunctionCall exist as .cpp/.h pairs in src/common/expression
src/common/function contains FunctionManager.cpp/.h, GraphFunction.h, plus AggFunctionManager and FunctionUdfManager, with a test/ subdirectory

full_card.band: Tier 20h (seed proposed 8h, too tight: frontier estimate ~12h plus build iteration). Partial credit per operator family and per function family. Weaker model stalls at build/link stage.
full_card.build_cost: Unverified. Estimate: pre-stage third-party bundle at image build (network allowed there), then full build around 1-3 h on 8 cores; memory peak unknown; probably 3-5 days of harness work
full_card.deliverable: Restored C++ expression evaluators (arithmetic, relational, logical, container, list comprehension, predicate, reduce, function call) and FunctionManager built-in table so common ctest binaries link and pass
full_card.gates_anticheat: Hidden ctest binaries and generated trees kept outside image; purge any built nebula libs or ccache from image; reject edits to test or CMake config; forbid vendoring libnebula; history-less snapshot blocks upstream recovery
full_card.grading_surface: Upstream expression/function ctest binaries plus generated expression trees; exact value and null/error propagation match; fraction of cases passed
full_card.local_fit: Build not verified offline. Full NebulaGraph needs pre-staged third-party bundle; 8 cores and 16 GB at link time is a risk and is unverified
full_card.lookup: partial: upstream is public in git history and the code is widely seen, so a model may recall outline; history-less snapshot closes direct lookup
full_card.provenance: vesoft-inc/nebula, Apache-2.0, v3.8.0 release at head 426266b; 12.4k stars, not archived, not a fork
full_card.reference: Upstream source at 426266b for the removed area; scores 1 by definition; size 4-6k lines per seed (not verified)

spike_plan.kill_if: Third-party bundle cannot be staged for offline use, or the common lib build exceeds 16 GB or cannot finish in about 3 h wall time, which would trigger K7 or K12.
spike_plan.pass_if: Third-party staging completes offline-reproducible, common lib builds within 16 GB peak, and expression ctest runs deterministically on the untouched tree.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone vesoft-inc/nebula at 426266b (no further fetches to the pipeline platform).
Run third-party/install-third-party.sh to stage the dependency bundle; record size and wall time. This is the offline-build prerequisite.
Configure with -DENABLE_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release and build only the common library target with -j8; record wall time and peak RSS (/usr/bin/time -v).
Delete src/common/expression/*.cpp and the FunctionManager sources in a copy; rebuild the common lib and one ctest binary; confirm link failure is the only failure.
Check whether the expression ctest binaries build and run on the untouched tree and record pass count, to confirm the suite is deterministic across three runs.
Check the image does not retain build outputs that expose the removed code (object files, ccache, install prefix).

v1.summary: The source is real: the upstream nebula v3.8.0 tree is Apache-2.0 and the expression and function directories exist as described, but the seed's 4-6k line size, 8h band and offline build are unverified and the smoke build is empty. The idea survives with a build-feasibility spike, and the tier should be 20h rather than 8h because the frontier estimate is about 12h.
